title: Going over Fine Web with a Fine-Tooth Comb: Technical Report of Indexing Fine Web for Problematic Content Search and Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Using an Elasticsearch-based pipeline to index massive LLM training datasets and querying them against the 'Weaponized Words' dictionary to identify the presence and distribution of language-specific curse words, slurs, and toxic or discriminatory language.

Executing targeted search queries for specific anti-transgender terminology (e.g., 'transtrenders') across the indexed training corpus to retrieve, score, and analyze textual snippets containing the discriminatory term.
